en.html: What—what was this? A voice? This was supposed to be SOUND? As if somebody had taken a hammer to my brain, done the job very thoroughly, ground the pieces under a millstone until full paste, and then put the whole bloody preparation on to roast. That impact, that sensation—◆THAT was a voice!? Whose!?
en.text:
What—what was this?

A voice?

This was supposed to be SOUND?

As if somebody had taken a hammer to my brain, done the job very thoroughly, ground the pieces under a millstone until full paste, and then put the whole bloody preparation on to roast. That impact, that sensation—◆THAT was a voice!?

Whose!?

ja.html: 何だ――これは。 　声？ 　音なのか、これは？ 　脳髄を金槌で念入りに打ち砕いたうえ石臼にかけて すり潰しペースト状になったところを焙り焼きにする ようなこの衝撃、感触――――◆これが音声!? 　誰の・・!?

en.html:
Wolf"I was the seeker pursuing God. She was the prophet carrying God's voice."
Wolf"And we met."
Wolf"Meeting her gave my reasoning a basis. Meeting me let her understand what she was sensing. Each of us had the missing piece of the other's head."
Wolf"Now we have God's exact coordinates. Tamanawa in Sagami, in the Yamato Empire: from Fudaraku Castle, one hundred fifteen kilometers toward the Earth's center!"
Wolf"There God is. And a way to open the road to him, that also exists!"
Wolf"Silver Star! In this very age we have the supreme tsurugi, the child closest to the parent from which they descend!"
Wolf"The conditions are ready to THIS extent! Toh, my friends—WHAT ARE WE TO DO?!"
